The '''Model-3287''' was a type of [[luma flare]] produced by [[Salamini Chemical Munitions]]. It was not designed as a weapon, mainly for emergency illumination or signaling for an [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] strike, but it did have offensive capabilities when fired within 20 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of someone.
